hook: Bitten by a shark, 65 miles from New Orleans.
narration: This man had just been bitten by a shark, sixty-five miles from New Orleans.
He was fishing near Breton Island aboard the motor vessel Predator.
A Coast Guard crew from Air Station New Orleans hovered over the boat as it pushed through the chop.
The flight mechanic calls every move to the pilot over the intercom. Forward, right, hold.
The rescue basket went down to the deck, and he was loaded in.
outcome: And the Air Station New Orleans crew hoisted him off the Predator and medevaced him.
title: Shark bite 65 miles off New Orleans
description:
On Aug. 1, 2009, a Coast Guard Air Station New Orleans helicopter crew medevaced a man from the motor vessel Predator after he was bitten by a shark while fishing near Breton Island, about 65 miles southeast of New Orleans.
